From: Buddy Williams <buddy.williams@insurity.com>
Subject: Bug Report: Refine leaks refine/* branches on origin �X cleanup-worktrees can never prune them

Body:
Bug Report: Refine leaks refine/* branches on origin �X cleanup-worktrees can never prune them

  Component: refine �X worktree_cleanup (src/tools/product/worktree_cleanup/mod.rs)
  Version observed: refine 4.2.0 (checkout HEAD 7556a231, /insurity/refine)
  Target app: ProSuite (/insurity/ProSuite), node bo2lnxnevo03-buddy, merge_target_branch = insurity-claims
  Severity: Medium (no data loss; unbounded remote-branch growth, operational noise, misleading cleanup output)

  Summary

  Origin has accumulated 90 refine/* refs (89 goal round-branches + refine/state) that grow without bound. refine project cleanup-worktrees reports 0 eligible on every run and never deletes a
  remote branch, even for goals whose work is fully merged into insurity-claims. The remote-branch retirement logic has three structural gaps that make large classes of branches permanently
  un-prunable.

  Observed vs. expected

  Observed (refine project cleanup-worktrees, dry-run):
  worktrees:  inspected 57, eligible 0, preserved 57
  branches:   inspected 79, eligible 0, remote_branches_deleted 0
  reasons:    candidate_not_integrated 75, goal_not_found 4
  Origin round-branches by current goal status: failed 26, backlog 23, review 15, quality 11, done 7, cancelled 1, no-goal-record 6. Local refine/* branches: 138; linked worktrees: 60.

  Expected: branches whose commits are provably contained in the configured merge target (insurity-claims) and whose goals are terminal (done / cancelled / record-deleted) should be retired from
  origin; the tool should report a non-zero eligible set here.

  Root cause (code-level)

  The only path that deletes a remote branch is execute_branch_retirement �� delete_remote_branch_if_matches (worktree_cleanup/mod.rs:614), reachable only when integrated_branch_plan returns
  Eligible. That gate (matching_integration, lines 638�V646) requires the branch's local tip to exactly equal a workflow_integration.candidate_commit recorded on one of the goal's rounds. Three
  consequences:

  1. Origin-only strays are invisible. cleanup_orphaned_integrated_branches iterates git.list_refine_owned_branches() �X local branches only. Once the local branch/worktree is gone (e.g. the goal
  record was deleted), the pushed origin branch is never revisited. �� Goal 00000SZP9NZ81GEQ11ZYWMC000 has 6 origin-only branches (round-2�K7), all merged into insurity-claims HEAD, no local
  branch, no worktree �X permanently stranded, not even inspected.
  2. Checked-out integrated branches are skipped. Line 326 if checked_out.contains(&branch) { continue; }. 60 worktrees pin their branches; an integrated goal whose worktree is never torn down
  (e.g. refine/00000SZ65RCHM0033AZCN8001Q/round-1, tip == recorded candidate aa4b91cb, ancestor of insurity-claims) keeps its origin branch forever, because branch retirement is only a
  side-effect of worktree removal �X which is --apply-only and clean-only.
  3. No prune path for non-integrated or superseded rounds. failed/backlog/review/quality/cancelled goals (76 branches) have no workflow_integration, and superseded earlier rounds (e.g. a goal
  with round-1�Kround-9 where only the final round integrated) never match a candidate commit. goal_not_found branches are also explicitly held (Preserved) rather than retired even when merged.
  These live on origin indefinitely.

  Reproduction

  1. Run several goals to integration on a project whose merge_target_branch is a shared branch (insurity-claims), leaving worktrees in place; delete/supersede some goals.
  2. refine project cleanup-worktrees �� branch_eligible: 0, remote_branches_deleted: 0.
  3. git branch -r | grep refine/ �� branches persist even for merged, terminal goals.

  Verified-safe cleanup inventory (no work lost �X tips already in insurity-claims HEAD)

  - 6 �X refine/00000SZP9NZ81GEQ11ZYWMC000/round-{2..7} (goal record deleted; all merged)
  - 5 �X done goals merged into HEAD: �KRCHM�K/round-1, �KRDR0�K/round-1, �KS9K�K/round-1, �KSH07�K/round-1, �KEH3C�K/round-1
  - = 11 branches safe to delete from origin.
  - Do NOT touch: refine/state; the 76 in-flight branches; and 2 done branches not yet in HEAD (�KSMQP�K/round-1, �KRPMC�K/round-1) �X origin holds the only copy.

  Note on the "control-state syncing removed" premise

  In this deployed 4.2.0 checkout, control-state sync is fully present and wired (REFINE_STATE_BRANCH = "refine/state", GIT_SYNC_RUNNER, FileGitSyncService), and origin/refine/state was last
  updated 2026-08-13 (91738db, "Sync Refine state: 1 goal"). So either this checkout predates the removal you're referring to, or the removal lives in a version not yet deployed here �X worth
  reconciling. Relevant either way: if state sync is retired, refine/state on origin becomes an orphaned branch with no janitor, so the removal should ship with a migration that deletes it �X and,
  critically, removing state sync does not address the round-branch leak above, which is a separate worktree_cleanup defect.

  Suggested fixes

  - Add a remote-first pass: retire an origin/refine/* branch when its goal record is absent (or terminal) and its tip is an ancestor of the configured merge target on the remote �X verifiable
  without a local branch.
  - Decouple branch retirement from worktree removal; retire the origin branch for checked-out-but-integrated branches.
  - Add explicit prune handling for cancelled goals and superseded (non-final) rounds.
  - Make goal_not_found + merged-into-target eligible (keeping the ancestor safety check) instead of blanket-preserve.
  - If state sync is being retired, add a migration step that deletes origin/refine/state.

Subject: Bug Report: Refine leaks refine/* branches on origin �X cleanup-worktrees can never prune them

Body:
Bug Report: Refine leaks refine/* branches on origin �X cleanup-worktrees can never prune them

  Component: refine �X worktree_cleanup (src/tools/product/worktree_cleanup/mod.rs)
  Version observed: refine 4.2.0 (checkout HEAD 7556a231, /insurity/refine)
  Target app: ProSuite (/insurity/ProSuite), node bo2lnxnevo03-buddy, merge_target_branch = insurity-claims
  Severity: Medium (no data loss; unbounded remote-branch growth, operational noise, misleading cleanup output)

  Summary

  Origin has accumulated 90 refine/* refs (89 goal round-branches + refine/state) that grow without bound. refine project cleanup-worktrees reports 0 eligible on every run and never deletes a
  remote branch, even for goals whose work is fully merged into insurity-claims. The remote-branch retirement logic has three structural gaps that make large classes of branches permanently
  un-prunable.

  Observed vs. expected

  Observed (refine project cleanup-worktrees, dry-run):
  worktrees:  inspected 57, eligible 0, preserved 57
  branches:   inspected 79, eligible 0, remote_branches_deleted 0
  reasons:    candidate_not_integrated 75, goal_not_found 4
  Origin round-branches by current goal status: failed 26, backlog 23, review 15, quality 11, done 7, cancelled 1, no-goal-record 6. Local refine/* branches: 138; linked worktrees: 60.

  Expected: branches whose commits are provably contained in the configured merge target (insurity-claims) and whose goals are terminal (done / cancelled / record-deleted) should be retired from
  origin; the tool should report a non-zero eligible set here.

  Root cause (code-level)

  The only path that deletes a remote branch is execute_branch_retirement �� delete_remote_branch_if_matches (worktree_cleanup/mod.rs:614), reachable only when integrated_branch_plan returns
  Eligible. That gate (matching_integration, lines 638�V646) requires the branch's local tip to exactly equal a workflow_integration.candidate_commit recorded on one of the goal's rounds. Three
  consequences:

  1. Origin-only strays are invisible. cleanup_orphaned_integrated_branches iterates git.list_refine_owned_branches() �X local branches only. Once the local branch/worktree is gone (e.g. the goal
  record was deleted), the pushed origin branch is never revisited. �� Goal 00000SZP9NZ81GEQ11ZYWMC000 has 6 origin-only branches (round-2�K7), all merged into insurity-claims HEAD, no local
  branch, no worktree �X permanently stranded, not even inspected.
  2. Checked-out integrated branches are skipped. Line 326 if checked_out.contains(&branch) { continue; }. 60 worktrees pin their branches; an integrated goal whose worktree is never torn down
  (e.g. refine/00000SZ65RCHM0033AZCN8001Q/round-1, tip == recorded candidate aa4b91cb, ancestor of insurity-claims) keeps its origin branch forever, because branch retirement is only a
  side-effect of worktree removal �X which is --apply-only and clean-only.
  3. No prune path for non-integrated or superseded rounds. failed/backlog/review/quality/cancelled goals (76 branches) have no workflow_integration, and superseded earlier rounds (e.g. a goal
  with round-1�Kround-9 where only the final round integrated) never match a candidate commit. goal_not_found branches are also explicitly held (Preserved) rather than retired even when merged.
  These live on origin indefinitely.

  Reproduction

  1. Run several goals to integration on a project whose merge_target_branch is a shared branch (insurity-claims), leaving worktrees in place; delete/supersede some goals.
  2. refine project cleanup-worktrees �� branch_eligible: 0, remote_branches_deleted: 0.
  3. git branch -r | grep refine/ �� branches persist even for merged, terminal goals.

  Verified-safe cleanup inventory (no work lost �X tips already in insurity-claims HEAD)

  - 6 �X refine/00000SZP9NZ81GEQ11ZYWMC000/round-{2..7} (goal record deleted; all merged)
  - 5 �X done goals merged into HEAD: �KRCHM�K/round-1, �KRDR0�K/round-1, �KS9K�K/round-1, �KSH07�K/round-1, �KEH3C�K/round-1
  - = 11 branches safe to delete from origin.
  - Do NOT touch: refine/state; the 76 in-flight branches; and 2 done branches not yet in HEAD (�KSMQP�K/round-1, �KRPMC�K/round-1) �X origin holds the only copy.

  Note on the "control-state syncing removed" premise

  In this deployed 4.2.0 checkout, control-state sync is fully present and wired (REFINE_STATE_BRANCH = "refine/state", GIT_SYNC_RUNNER, FileGitSyncService), and origin/refine/state was last
  updated 2026-08-13 (91738db, "Sync Refine state: 1 goal"). So either this checkout predates the removal you're referring to, or the removal lives in a version not yet deployed here �X worth
  reconciling. Relevant either way: if state sync is retired, refine/state on origin becomes an orphaned branch with no janitor, so the removal should ship with a migration that deletes it �X and,
  critically, removing state sync does not address the round-branch leak above, which is a separate worktree_cleanup defect.

  Suggested fixes

  - Add a remote-first pass: retire an origin/refine/* branch when its goal record is absent (or terminal) and its tip is an ancestor of the configured merge target on the remote �X verifiable
  without a local branch.
  - Decouple branch retirement from worktree removal; retire the origin branch for checked-out-but-integrated branches.
  - Add explicit prune handling for cancelled goals and superseded (non-final) rounds.
  - Make goal_not_found + merged-into-target eligible (keeping the ancestor safety check) instead of blanket-preserve.
  - If state sync is being retired, add a migration step that deletes origin/refine/state.
